name: Aura Concert & Cinema
summary:
Aura Concert & Cinema isn't just an app; it's a whole new way to experience sound and visuals.

Turn your music into an immersive concert and feel every note as if you were right there on stage. Step into your own personal movie theater where your films and videos come to life with a level of realism that completely transforms the experience.

Thanks to its powerful spatial sound, forget about flat audio: every detail surrounds you, envelops you, and makes you feel like you're right there in the moment.
